title: Security, Persistence, and Production Hardening
objective: Harden PantryPilot for a real public competition deployment (security, local browser persistence, production UX/config) without changing the core recommendation behavior validated in Module E. Deployment itself is out of scope.
in_scope: 4.1 Input validation audit (confirmed already implemented in Module A/B/C schemas; no functional gap found)
4.2 Request body size limits on body-accepting endpoints
4.3 Rate limiting on /api/recommend and /api/ingredients/suggest
4.4 CORS audit (confirmed already env-driven and safe-by-default; residual test coverage only)
4.5 Secrets/environment audit (confirmed already clean; no functional change)
4.6 Error sanitization audit (confirmed already implemented via PantryPilotError envelope; no functional change)
4.7 Logging hygiene review and minimal structured logging (request ID, endpoint, latency, failure category)
4.8 Prompt/tool injection boundary regression test (one targeted end-to-end adversarial-content test)
4.9 URL safety audit (confirmed already implemented via frontend safeUrl.js and fixed provider base URL; no functional change)
4.10 Dependency security scan (backend pip-audit, frontend npm audit) wired into CI, findings documented
5.1 Pantry persistence (local, versioned storage)
5.2 Search-form preference persistence (servings, max time, difficulty, cuisine) — budget explicitly excluded per Founder decision
5.3 Recent-search history (bounded, rerun, clear)
5.4 Saved/favorite recipes (minimal provider-grounded fields only)
5.5 Clear/reset controls for all local state, no devtools required
6. Production UX hardening (failure-state message review/fixes)
7. Accessibility light pass (labels, keyboard, focus, aria-live, contrast)
8. Production configuration review (env-driven CORS/API origin; already largely satisfied)
9. Health/readiness endpoint review (confirmed already minimal and compliant)
11. Module F security report under docs/
Separate clearly-labeled commit correcting stale Module E status in CURRENT_STATUS.md
out_of_scope: Payments, social sharing, meal plans, nutrition generation, grocery ordering, retailer integrations
Any change to ranking weights (45/30/15/10), MAX_SEARCH_ATTEMPTS=3, MAX_EVALUATED_CANDIDATES=20, max 3 primary recommendations
affected_modules: Agent Orchestrator (test-only addition, no logic change)
forbidden_paths: Any deployment/infrastructure config (Nginx, systemd, Docker, SSL)
acceptance_criteria: Oversized request bodies return a controlled 413 before reaching Pydantic validation or any agent/provider call
Requests exceeding the rate limit on /api/recommend or /api/ingredients/suggest return 429 in the existing error-envelope shape, with no provider/LLM call made
No secret appears in any response body, log line, or frontend bundle
Reload restores pantry, search-form preferences (excluding budget), and recent-search history without duplicates
Recent-search history is capped, supports rerun and clear
Saved recipes store only provider-grounded minimal fields
A single control clears all local state without developer tools
All frozen behavior invariants unchanged: full existing backend pytest suite passes with no modification to ranking/bounds logic
Full quality gate green: backend pytest, frontend vitest, frontend lint, frontend production build, backend/frontend dependency audit, secret-pattern scan, governance validation, CI
security_acceptance: Request bounds enforced (size + rate) — new for Module F
Secrets absent from Git/frontend build — reconfirmed, no change needed
Prompt injection tests pass — reconfirmed via new targeted regression test
Dependency/security scans have no unresolved critical issue without Founder-accepted risk
performance_reliability_acceptance: Rate limiting must not measurably degrade normal interactive use (limits chosen to exceed realistic single-user usage)
In-memory rate limiter is documented as a competition-scope limitation (resets on restart, not multi-instance safe) per Founder-approved plan
data_integrity_acceptance: Local persistence uses versioned storage; a schema-version mismatch safely resets rather than corrupting app state
No generated recipe content is ever persisted; saved recipes remain provider-grounded
required_tests: Backend: rate-limit 429 test asserting no downstream provider/LLM call
Backend: adversarial-content end-to-end injection regression test
migration_impact: NONE (no backend schema change; frontend introduces a versioned localStorage scheme with explicit migrate-or-reset-on-mismatch behavior)
configuration_impact: New env vars for rate-limit thresholds and max request body size, with documented defaults
observability_impact: Minimal structured logging added (request ID, endpoint, latency, high-level failure category); no secrets logged
known_risks: In-memory rate limiting resets on process restart and is not multi-instance safe — acceptable for single-VM competition deployment, documented in the Module F security report
Any backend dependency vulnerability without a safe non-major fix will be documented per package/CVE/exposure/mitigation rather than force-upgraded
implementation_notes: Claude must not expand scope beyond this ticket. Budget is never persisted (Founder decision). Saved/favorite recipes are in scope but minimal. CURRENT_STATUS.md correction ships as its own separate, clearly-labeled commit distinct from Module F functional commits.
